concept: A pane that comes in from an edge over a dimmed scene: a bottom sheet with a grabber on a phone, a side panel on a wide screen.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a full-width white drawer that slides over a black backdrop (Material bottom sheet)
default_to_avoid.kind: sheet, bottom sheet, side sheet, panel
default_to_avoid.why_not: a white slab owns a colour and a hard edge; it ignores the stack and the light

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: a level-3 pane at an edge, its corners round only away from the edge it belongs to

derivation.consequence: panes enter by rising a short distance and settling, as an object placed in space would
derivation.form: it comes in from its edge and settles; dragging the grabber down far enough closes it

derivation.consequence: keyboard reaches everything a pointer can, with a visible focus ring on any backdrop
derivation.form: focus is trapped inside, Esc closes it, and the grabber is never the only way out

options: A level-3 pane from an edge
variants.picked: A level-3 pane from an edge
variants.reason: A belongs to its edge and to the measured stack. B ignores both. C floats free and loses the connection to the edge it came from.

scrim.why: the scrim dims the scene under the sheet

sheet.why: a level-3 pane fixed to an edge, scrolling inside itself

bottom.why: from the bottom: round top corners, square bottom ones, short of the top of the screen

start.why: from the start edge: round corners only on its end side

end.why: from the end edge: round corners only on its start side

grabber.why: a bar to drag the sheet down, with a 44px press area around it

title.why: the title in the title size, the accessible name

description.why: a sentence in secondary text under the title

body.why: the content on the overlay gap, the same in every theme and on every scene

actions.why: actions at the foot, the loud one last

hidden.why: a title kept for screen readers when it is hidden visually, never shown on the sheet itself

preview.why: drawn in place for documentation: open, not modal, full width of its parent

focus-visible.why: the shared focus ring on the pane or control so a keyboard user sees where they are

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours draw an outline so the overlay keeps its edge without the glass

@fade.why: the scrim fades in, zero under reduced motion

@from-bottom.why: the sheet comes up from the bottom edge and settles

@from-start.why: the panel slides in from the start edge

@from-end.why: the panel slides in from the end edge

translate.why: the sheet follows the finger while dragged and springs back at press pace
